description: A thin brown cigarillo with a plastic tip, sweetened to smell of cherries. It still tastes of cigar.

overdose.message: You inhaled it. Your head spins and your stomach turns over.

phases.comeup_message: The cigar catches. The smoke is thick and sweet and fills your mouth.
end_message: The cigar has gone out, and you don't relight it.
You stub the cigar out and leave it.
peak_message: You roll the smoke round your mouth and let it go.
The cigar makes you feel like you own the place.
You tap off an inch of ash and feel very pleased with yourself.

effects.take_line: You light the cigarillo. The smoke smells of cherries and tastes of cigar.

withdrawal.message: You keep thinking about the cigar you had.

stages.easing: Your hands find other things to do, badly.
stages.onset: Your hand reaches for a cigarette that isn't there.
stages.peak: You've reached for the empty pocket eleven times in the last hour, and you're doing it again.
stages.rising: It keeps happening: pocket, mouth, pocket, before you remember.
stages.tail: You've mostly stopped reaching. Once an afternoon, your hand still goes to your pocket.

name: cherry cigarillo
